scope: retrospective descriptive 12h follow-up of same frozen cohort; no tuning or independent validation
parameterSources: 12h horizon, +/-900s endpoint and MAX_LUKA=1200 from existing jakosc-historii-kart.mjs; not fitted here
cohort: all 154 original rows, separate ps/pc; target checks only six original investment flags; separately report five inReach
endpoint: closest point to t+43200 within inclusive +/-900s; tie earlier; pending until entire window closes
path: only actually observed prices at t < timestamp <= t+43200; exclude tolerance tail from path
target: frozen original row[15], never current/revised target; observed price >= target
hitMeaning: first recorded at-or-above-target observation, not true first passage, executed sale or guaranteed liquidity
nonHitMeaning: target not observed in sampled prices; never conclude target was not reached between observations
coverage: number of prices and valid rating snapshots in strict 12h path, valid rating snapshots without matching card price, max consecutive price gap including both boundaries, gaps >1200s
missing: no imputation, no carry-forward, no replacing identity; endpoint absence separated from missing rating samples
excluded: confidence intervals from one dependent cohort
